# Kisumu Rental Marketplace - Project Instructions

## Project Overview
Full-stack rental marketplace platform for Kisumu, Kenya. Connects landlords with vacant properties to tenants seeking rentals.

**Tech Stack:** React (Frontend) | Go (Backend API) | PostgreSQL (Database)

## Key Features
- Property listings by area and price range
- Landlord: 1st free listing, then KSh.250 per listing
- Tenant: Pays KSh.150 on successful connection (landlord-verified)
- Landlord verification system with viewing scheduling
- Image uploads and property search
- User authentication and payment handling

## Development Guidelines
- Backend: Go with REST API using Gin or Echo framework
- Frontend: React with TypeScript, Vite, and TailwindCSS
- Database: PostgreSQL with migrations
- Use absolute imports and follow project structure
- Maintain separation between frontend, backend, and database layers
- All API endpoints must be RESTful and well-documented
